_comment: The four reference camera poses for the RISE image->scene-reconstruction eval (Wave 3). Machine-readable; consumed by Wave-5 checkpoints. Keep in sync with generate_references.sh and sdf_reconstruct_truth.RISEscene (view1 == the ground-truth scene camera). All cameras are pinhole; film is 256x256; fov is the RISE horizontal-ish full field-of-view in degrees; up is world +Y.

view1.role: primary front-3/4 (identical to the ground-truth scene camera)

view3.role: back-3/4 (+X,-Z; leans toward the notch side -- a pure -X,-Z back-left view self-occludes the +X notch entirely, see CALIBRATION.md)
